say:1:1130126001:1.source_cn: 就是那位魔法师梅林大人啊！

say:2:1130126002:1.text: The oasis of the Uru Settlement was created by Merlin's magic.
say:2:1130126002:1.source_cn: 乌尔聚落所处的这片绿洲，就是他用魔法创造出来的。

say:3:1130126003:1.text: And that's why we always give thanks when we fetch water.
say:3:1130126003:1.source_cn: 为了感谢他所做的一切，我们部落在取水时，都会念诵他的名字。

say:4:1130126004:1.text: You seem to be a mage as well. May I ask if you know Magister Merlin?
say:4:1130126004:1.source_cn: 你看起来也是魔法师，请问你认识梅林大人吗？
say:4:1130126004:1.male: You seem to be a mage as well. May I ask if you know Magister Merlin?

say:6:1130126005:1.text: That's amazing! Please give our thanks to him!

say:8:1130126006:1.text: That's too bad, he must have been really awesome! I bet you would have liked him!
